revela_tof_core.description: The board's time-of-flight core: the ToF pipeline -- the four latest reference phases to phase and amplitude, phase to depth in millimetres -- then a depth view a television shows, a rainbow red near to violet far. Of model blocks alone, it is the unit the board's ISP proves and builds whole, behind the frame store that hands it the four latest frames side by side.

clock_mhz.description: The clock the datapath is CUT for, above the clock it runs at: generation margin makes the cut placement deterministic. Whatever builds this ISP sets it.

bit_depth.description: The word each signed sample rides in.

frames.description: Frames the stream brings side by side, from the frame store.

headroom.description: Bits of each sample's word above its sign, always zero: the sensor's.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: The four latest phase frames side by side, from the frame store, each frame's count the newest's.

outputs.name: out
outputs.description: The depth view: three 8-bit channels in one word, R low, G mid, B high. The word's width is TRACED, not declared.

tof.description: Phase frames in, depth out: what any four-phase ToF sensor on this board needs.

view.description: Depth as a smooth rainbow across a range, red near through orange, yellow, green, cyan and blue to violet far, every millimetre of the depth feeding the blend; black where nothing was measured. This design's output encoding for HDMI. Its range resets to the sensor's whole window, 0-4.1 m.

revela_tof_isp.description: The board's time-of-flight ISP, in its ISP slot: the reference sensor's phase frames as they come -- a burst of four, then a wait -- kept by a frame store in external memory, the top 16 MB the board's Linux leaves alone, and the four latest handed to the core at the television's pace. Built for the sensor's whole frame, 240x180 of eleven-bit samples in the link's twelve-bit word, widened to sixteen.

clock_mhz.description: The clock the core's datapath is cut for; whatever builds this ISP sets it.

inputs.name: isp_in
inputs.description: One reference phase a frame from the bayerlink receiver, each frame's size and count in its header.

inputs.name: mem_rst
inputs.description: Active high: the memory's reset, the one reset of the frame store's master on it -- the board's, never the link's.

outputs.name: isp_out
outputs.description: The depth view, as the television's raster takes it, each frame's context with it.

outputs.name: mem
outputs.description: The memory the frames live in.

isp.description: The frame store, its frames from 0x1F000000 -- the 16 MB the board's kernel is told it does not have (mem=496M) -- then the core.
